title: One and Many
introduction: Practise one and many with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Singular words name one thing. Plural words name more than one.
rules: Many plural nouns end in s: book, books.
Some end in es: box, boxes.

grammar.description: Add es to words such as box.

examples.question: Two ___ (cat).
steps: Many plural nouns end in s: book, books.

examples.question: Three ___ (box).
steps: Some end in es: box, boxes.

summary: Singular words name one thing. Plural words name more than one.
